args.sql:
SELECT 
    c.name AS customer_name,
    SUM(p.price) AS total_beverage_spend
FROM sf_orders_0802 o
JOIN sf_order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN beverage_skus p ON oi.sku = p.sku
JOIN all_customers c ON o.customer = c.id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY total_beverage_spend DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT 
    o.id AS order_id,
    o.customer,
    c.name AS customer_name,
    oi.sku,
    p.price
FROM sf_orders_0802 o
JOIN sf_order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN beverage_skus p ON oi.sku = p.sku
JOIN all_customers c ON o.customer = c.id
ORDER BY p.price DESC
